title.zh: GitHub Copilot Fusion正式上线：跑分接近Claude Code，测试成本减半
title.en: GitHub Copilot Fusion正式上线：跑分接近Claude Code，测试成本减半

current_state.zh: GitHub launched Copilot Fusion, a multi-model routing system that dispatches simple tasks to cheaper models and escalates complex ones, with independent testing showing near-Claude-Code coding scores at about 51% lower cost and 40% faster runtime.
